address.title: Address
address.description: The HCP Terraform API address. Defaults to https://app.terraform.io.

rateLimit.title: Rate Limit
rateLimit.description: The ceiling on how fast requests launch, in requests per second; omitted, the client's default of 30 (HCP Terraform's documented limit) applies. The client adapts downward from the server's rate-limit feedback on its own, so set this only for an organization whose granted limit sits well below the default and the run should not probe past it.

organizations.title: Organizations
organizations.description: Limits the run to the named organizations. Names match exactly; there are no glob patterns. An empty list archives every organization the token can see.

projects.title: Projects
projects.description: Limits the run to the named projects within each archived organization. Names match exactly; there are no glob patterns. An empty list archives every project. With both projects and workspaces set, a workspace must satisfy both filters.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.description: Limits the run to the named workspaces within each archived organization. Names match exactly; there are no glob patterns. An empty list archives every workspace. With both projects and workspaces set, a workspace must satisfy both filters.

include.title: Include
include.description: Selects the heavy or optional surfaces to archive, each off by default.

runHistory.title: Run History
runHistory.description: Bounds how much of each workspace's run history a run fetches; unset fetches every run.

archive.title: Archive
archive.description: Locates the archive on local disk; unset leaves the location to the --archive-path flag.

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: Mirrors the archive to a remote object store, evicting sealed cold bundles and settled tarballs and syncing everything else; unset keeps the whole archive on local disk.

extract.title: Extract
extract.description: Configures where the extract command writes; unset leaves the location to the --extract-path flag.

export.title: Export
export.description: Configures the export command: where it writes and the page templates it renders with. Unset leaves the location to the --export-path flag and keeps the built-in templates.

path.title: Path
path.description: The archive root directory: the default for the root command's --archive-path flag and for the read commands' [archive-path] positional. A relative path resolves against this file's directory. An explicit flag or positional always wins.

archive.title: Archive
archive.description: Locates the archive on local disk.

byteSize.title: Byte Size
byteSize.description: A byte count: a plain integer number of bytes, or a string with a decimal (KB, MB, GB, TB) or binary (KiB, MiB, GiB, TiB) suffix, such as 64MiB.

duration.title: Duration
duration.description: A duration: a string in Go duration syntax (ns, us, ms, s, m, h) extended with a day unit, such as 90d, 36h, or 1d12h, or 0 for the zero duration.

path.title: Path
path.description: The default --export-path directory the export command writes its markdown tree into. A relative path resolves against this file's directory. An explicit --export-path always wins.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Locates the page templates the export renders with; unset keeps the built-in templates.

export.title: Export
export.description: Configures the export command: the directory it writes into and the page templates it renders with.

path.title: Path
path.description: The default --extract-path directory the extract command recovers files into. A relative path resolves against this file's directory. An explicit --extract-path always wins.

extract.title: Extract
extract.description: Configures where the extract command writes.

registryDetail.title: Registry Detail
registryDetail.description: Enables the deeper registry version, platform, and binary detail.

auditTrail.title: Audit Trail
auditTrail.description: Enables archiving of the audit trail.

include.title: Include
include.description: Holds the opt-in toggles for the heavy or most organization-specific surfaces, each archived only when a configuration turns it on.

url.title: URL
url.description: Locates the bucket in gocloud.dev form, selecting the backend by scheme: "s3://bucket?region=us-east-1" (AWS S3, or a compatible store such as MinIO, R2, or Ceph RGW via endpoint and use_path_style query parameters), "azblob://container" (Azure Blob Storage), or "file:///path" (a local directory tree). Required when any other remote field is set.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: An optional key prefix objects are stored under: keys compose as <prefix>/<org>/<path>, and leading or trailing slashes in the prefix are normalized away.

upload.title: Upload
upload.description: Tunes the multipart uploads that carry large bodies to the store; unset takes each backend's defaults.

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: Mirrors the archive to a remote object store. With the section set, the store holds a complete copy: sealed cold bundles and settled configuration-version tarballs are evicted to it (uploaded, verified, then removed locally), and every other archive file is synced to it incrementally at each organization run's close, with local disk staying the canonical searchable copy. Setting any field requires URL; leaving the whole section unset keeps the archive entirely local. Credentials are never configured here: the URL's scheme selects the backend, and each backend authenticates through its provider's default chain (the AWS SDK chain for s3://, Azure's environment variables or DefaultAzureCredential for azblob://).

fetchCount.title: Fetch Count
fetchCount.description: Fetches the newest count runs of each workspace; zero means unbounded.

fetchAge.title: Fetch Age
fetchAge.description: Fetches each workspace's runs created within this window before the archive runs, as a duration string in Go syntax extended with a day unit, such as 90d or 2160h; zero means unbounded.

runHistory.title: Run History
runHistory.description: Bounds how much of each workspace's run history a run fetches. Each bound is a guarantee of inclusion, optional and off at its zero value; when both are set the run walk fetches whichever admits more history, so a run is archived while it sits among the newest fetchCount runs or was created within the fetchAge window. With neither bound set every run is fetched. The bounds limit what a run fetches; they never remove runs already archived.

path.title: Path
path.description: A directory of *.md.tmpl files overriding the export's built-in page templates by filename: archive, org, projects, project, workspace, stack, teams, variable-sets, and policy-sets, each with the .md.tmpl suffix. Pages without an override keep their default. A relative path resolves against this file's directory.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Locates the page templates the export command renders with.

partSize.title: Part Size
partSize.description: The upload part size for backends that split a large body into parts, as a plain byte count or a suffixed size such as 64MiB; omitted, the backend's default applies.

concurrency.title: Concurrency
concurrency.description: The number of upload parts in flight per bundle, at least one; omitted, the backend's default applies.

upload.title: Upload
upload.description: Tunes the multipart uploads that carry large bodies to the remote store. Each knob is optional; omitted, the backend's default applies.

title: hcp_archiver configuration
description: The hcp_archiver YAML configuration: what to archive and how. Every key is optional; an absent key takes its default. Per-run settings and the API token are supplied by flags and the environment instead, so this file never carries a credential, and any relative path resolves against the file's own directory.
